messages:
alice: Heads-up from the pg bench: ptq-int8 reranker v2 shows overall MRR -3.2% and NDCG@10 -2.6% vs float. weirdly the loss concentrates on queries with escape/encoding artifacts.

mike: any slices yet?

alice: i ran a quick slice. queries containing backslash, literal '\\n', patterns like '\\u' and HTML entities are ~3.8% of eval and MRR in that slice is -11.9%. rest of distribution is ~-0.5%.

sophia: that's specific. did tokenizer or preprocessing change between runs?

alice: tokenizer bins are the same. culprit looks like our "formatter" template that does html-escape + raw insertion. e.g. raw query: `How to install to C:\\Program Files\\MyApp` became formatted with extra escaping before tokenization, ending up with doubled backslashes.

charlie: ptq can amplify tiny logit shifts, so if tokenization adds or removes a boundary it could flip close ties. seen that before with punctuation.

mike: can you paste a minimal repro?

alice: sure. simplified:
query_raw = "How do I install to C:\\Program Files\\MyApp"
formatted = format_for_rerank(query_raw)
# formatted -> "How do I install to C:\\\\Program Files\\\\MyApp"
(the formatter runs html_escape after templating, so backslashes get escaped twice)

sophia: two action items: 1) add escape-aware slice to nightly bench that reports per-slice NDCG/MRR for any queries matching `[\\\\&<>]` 2) add a tiny ptq sanity test that runs a handful of escape-heavy queries through float and int8 and asserts top1 parity for those cases.

ci-bot: created issue #3429: "escape/encoding slices + ptq top1 sanity" and triggered extended holdout run 1: https://git.internal/r/3429

charlie: interim mitigation idea: normalise consecutive backslashes in the formatter before tokenization (collapse runs to a canonical length) so we don't change semantics for normal text but avoid double-escape artifacts. careful though about code snippets where exact backslashes matter.

mike: short term plan: (a) add per-slice metrics to nightly bench (b) run ptq with tokenizer-locked artifacts and seed + quant params logged (c) try formatter patch that disables html-escape for raw-code blocks and run smoke.

alice: i'll open a small PR that removes the extra html-escape pass for formatted templates and add the repro unit tests. will post CI outputs here when available.

sophia: please record exact per-slice NDCG/MRR deltas in the issue so product/ops can decide rollout. also add a note in the model onboarding doc about tokenizer-locked artifacts for ptq.

alice: done for the issue checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:
